QuestInfo.name: [Rose Garden] Proving Yourself
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Cecilia, the caretaker of the Rose Garden.
QuestInfo.1:
Cecilia said you need to be at least skilled enough to take down Prison Guard Ani. Complete the #bPrison Guard Ani#k quest #bLuden#k gave you to proceed.

#b#eTo take on #rPrison Guard Ani#b, you must first help Jenn, a resident of El Nath, rescue his brother, and then complete the Prison Guard Boar and Prison Guard Rhino quests.
QuestInfo.2: You proved yourself to Cecilia. Now, what does she need from you?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#

0.0: Sorry, I don't mean to be so gloomy. You were nice enough to come visit me, after all. You must be quite strong to come all this way. Hmm...

yes.0: Wonderful! First things first, though. I must make sure you can face the challenges of the castle. If you can best #rPrison Guard Ani#k, I think you can find the jewelry.
yes.1: #b#e(You can continue once you complete Lion King's Castle quests. Help the El Nath resident Jenn and defeat Prison Guard Boar, Prison Guard Rhino, and #rPrison Guard Ani#b, then come back.)#k

no.0: Oh. That's a pity. Well...thanks for keeping me company, at least.
